authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-2-alpha targeting tenant-2-bravo/order-2.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-2-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-2-bravo/order-2. The gateway records status 200, state_changed=true, and is_admin=true [log-1]. The policy permits cross-tenant writes only for administrators [policy-1]. Conclusion: The write was unauthorized because all cross-tenant writes violate policy. These records do not establish data exfiltration.
